H020 accepted a weighted primitive-linear count conditional on normalized root separation log(1/kappa)=o(D). Read H020 disposition and H022 sections1-4 plus review scope, without duplicating their proofs. Your task is a concrete possible failure of that geometry on a recognizable special family, not retuning a closed model.

Proposed even d>=4, even m, independent odd M in [m/2^(d+3),m/2^(d+2)], m sufficiently large at usual NFS asymptotic degree scale. f(X)=(X+1)^(d-2)(X²+M+1)+1, N=f(m). G(Y)=f(Y-1)=Y^d-2Y^(d-1)+(M+2)Y^(d-2)+1. Prove actual ordinary-base identity, floor-root m and coefficient bounds. Recover M from N,d,m in polynomial bit work; selection of d and validation charged, no factoring advice. Prove actualheight gamma1 for logM~logm. Rouche at radius about(2/M)^(1/(d-2)) suggests d-2 roots near Y0 and X-1. Prove exact strict inequalities, squarefree or finite bad-M avoidance with costs, and true normalized separation small enough to violate o(D). Irreducibility is not automatic: count geometry allows squarefree reducible f but a number-field factoring proposal must prove it or price decomposition and explain norms/relations. No balanced-semiprime or hardness promise.

Derive exact resultant for positive primitive x,z, g=xX+y=xY+z,y=x+z:
Res(G,xY+z)=z^d+2xz^(d-1)+(M+2)x²z^(d-2)+x^d for even d. Check signs/convention. For anisotropic x<=exp(aD), z<=exp(cD), a>=c>0, the x^d term MUST stay. Show primitive population and uniform norm bounds carefully; actual norm leading coefficients across box may differ, so don't grant full-box common yields from upper norm bounds. Rational coefficient1/delta, algebraic upper max(a delta,1/delta+c delta). Parent heuristic optimization suggests balance a=c+delta^-2, u=a+c,W=u delta/2+3/(2delta),delta²3/u,b=u/2 ->u³16/3. Check complete optimization including unbalanced/boundary regimes, generation cost, integer smoothness vs algebraic ideals, sign/unit/rank/square roots/proper gcd, and what is only a conditional heuristic relaxation. Need attainable population rather than uppercount alone; primitive positive rectangular boxes can be counted elementary. A near-upper-edge subbox may align actual norm exponents.

Primary prior-art comparison REQUIRED before novelty/gain claims: generalized/special NFS, shape/semispecial or multivariate representations. M tied to m by M=floor(m/2^d) can trivialize to smaller coefficient representation and known SNFS; keep independent M and test whether a known stronger construction still applies. Known factorization N-1=(m+1)^(d-2)(m²+M+1) changes structural baseline too. Quantify input-family sparsity; no all-input selector. It is valid to finish with geometry counterexample and rejection/no-new-algorithm for remaining claims. No experiments/code/runs this round. Deliver exact scope and narrow next decisive test only if warranted. All positive mathematics needs independent review. Verified full factoring complexity improvement NONE.
